source_basis.fact: The open IP62 manual marks parasitic extraction unavailable and provides no foundry RC/PEX deck.
The derived LEF provides nominal width, sheet resistance, area capacitance, and edge capacitance.
The legacy deck recognizes RR/RS bodies and publishes a CSIO area coefficient of 0.615 fF/um^2.
F_RR compact model contains explicit PLUS-to-SUB capacitance formulas.
BSIM3 compact models contain gate-source and gate-drain overlap coefficients.

M2_M1.basis: engineering proxy: minimum adjacent-metal LEF area capacitance for M1/M2 overlap; no inter-metal coupling coefficient is published

M3_M2.basis: engineering proxy: minimum of M3 and M2 LEF area capacitance; no inter-metal coupling coefficient is published

M3_M1.basis: engineering proxy: M3 LEF area capacitance; no M3-to-M1 inter-metal coefficient is published

M3_SUBSTRATE.basis: engineering proxy: M3 LEF area capacitance; use only for explicitly net-assigned M3 geometry

F_RS.basis: engineering proxy: legacy CSIO coefficient 0.615 fF/um^2; no direct GR/F_RS substrate-capacitance coefficient is published

F_RR.basis: evaluate the source F_RR c_d0 PLUS-SUB expression; c_d1 MINUS-SUB is zero

PMOS.basis: BSIM3 PMOS cgsl/cgdl from models_IP62_mos_v2.lib; compact model owns these terms

NMOS.basis: BSIM3 NMOS cgsl/cgdl from models_IP62_mos_v2.lib; compact model owns these terms
